text.description_html:
First Impressions CFMBR-833KR Decorative Victorian Appliance Handle

This very decorative victorian design appliance handle is 1-3/16" Diameter with a 3-1/4" projection. They are hand made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions in your choice of 5 standard finishes.

This Victorian design appliance pull is reminiscent of the late 1800's, very elaborate yet graceful, that embellished the european homes of the noble and wealthy.

Also available: Matching Cabinet Knobs and Victorian Door Stop.

It is packaged with mounting screws for a refrigerator / appliance door panel. We believe a refrigerator needs to have a 18" or longer pull installed to effectively pull open todays large "vacuum" sealed doors such as the ones found on a Sub Zero refrigerator.

Specifications of First Impressions CFMBR-833KR Decorative Victorian Appliance Handle

  • Handle Diameter: 1-3/16"
  • Projection: 3-1/4"
  • Base Rosette Diameter: 1-15/16"
  • Material: Brass
  • Available Finishes: 5

This appliance pull is available in 6 different standard lengths.

  • FII-CFMBR-833KR-14: Total Length 14" - Center to Center Mount - 12-3/8"
  • FII-CFMBR-833KR-16: Total Length 16" - Center to Center Mount - 14-3/8"
  • FII-CFMBR-833KR-18: Total Length 18" - Center to Center Mount - 16-3/8"
  • FII-CFMBR-833KR-20: Total Length 20" - Center to Center Mount - 18-3/8"
  • FII-CFMBR-833KR-24: Total Length 24" - Center to Center Mount - 22-3/8"
  • FII-CFMBR-833KR-30: Total Length 30" - Center to Center Mount - 28-3/8"

    • Note: This victorian appliance handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the appliance handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

    These Refrigerator pulls are supplied with countersunk screws for mounting to 3/4" - 1" thick panels (standard appliance panel thickness).

    *Sold Individually.
